translation: Kada ku shigo da abin ƙyama cikin gidanku, kuma ku zama kamar haramtattun abubuwa kamar shi; ku ƙi shi da ƙyaurar ƙyama, kuma ku ɓata shi da ɓatarwar ƙyama, domin abin da aka haramta gaba ɗaya shi ⟨ne⟩.

tokens.gloss: ku ƙi shi da ƙyaurar ƙyama
ku ɓata shi da ɓatarwar ƙyama
abin da aka haramta gaba ɗaya
